name: Boots Essentials Cucumber Facial Toner 150ml (International)
description:
Description:
Refresh and tone your skin with the Boots Essentials Cucumber Facial Toner. Enriched with soothing cucumber and vitamins, this toner effectively removes the last traces of makeup and excess oils after cleansing, leaving your skin feeling revitalized and balanced.

Key Features:

Soothing Formula: Cucumber and vitamins calm and refresh the skin.

Removes Residue: Eliminates leftover makeup and excess oils.

Suitable for All Skin Types: Gentle and safe for everyday use.

Dermatologically Tested: Ensures high-quality care for your skin.

Made in UK

Perfect for maintaining fresh, clean, and toned skin as part of your daily skincare routine.
